notes.title: Patch 0.13.4
notes.notes:
[h1] BUG FIXES [/h1]

- Painting multiple objects sometimes the objects would be grouped together and you wouldn't be able to interact with just one, this is now fixed.
- Basic Grass had graphical issues fixed
- Tutorial null reference error after completion has been fixed

[h1] IMPROVEMENTS [/h1]

- Terrain Painting is now 3x more efficient

[h1] COMING SOON [/h1]

- Multiplayer
I have been working on multiplayer behind the scenes for a while now and it is almost complete. Undo and redo set me back a bit as on the network side it is very complex but hopefully I will be able to give you guys multiplayer very soon

- Import
Object importing is almost complete as well, I am mainly just working out the flow to make it as easy as possible for everyone. Thank you for your patience!

notes.notes:
[h1] BUG FIXES / IMPROVEMENTS [/h1]

- Scaling is now 3x faster
- Max scale is 1/2
- Tutorial bot is now closer to you
- Tutorial block no longer gets deleted after first grab
- Grass secondary color now updates properly
- Simple grass can now have it's properties edited
- Grass UI now matches the rest of the UI
- Radial menu stopped working sometimes - This should be fixed now

- Tutorial bot now repeats himself if the action isn't complete after 20 seconds

- Object Painting now has Undo and Redo
- Fog and Grass are now effected by wind



Undo /Redo for terrain and grass painting should be completed tomorrow.
Also going to give you some more grass options

notes.title: STEAMWORKS - Patch 0.12b
notes.notes:
[h1] WORKSHOP [/h1]

You guys asked for it and you got it, a lot faster than I thought I could do it! Well anyways basic workshop support is here you can now upload and download worlds! WOOOOOO, please upload some worlds I would love to see what you guys have created and I want to add them to a new trailer! 

[h1] HOW TO UPLOAD A WORLD [/h1]

Just select a world you want to upload and click upload, once that is done you can go to the steam works page and change the Name / Description and set it to public

[h1] HOW TO DOWNLOAD A WORLD [/h1]

Go to the World Builder Steam Workshop and subscribe to a world! Then when you open the app they will be on the "Workshop Worlds" Tab in home base!

[h1] FEATURES [/h1]

- Delete old worlds
- Did I mention Steam Workshop?

[h1] BUG FIXES [/h1]

- Fog now loads correctly

notes.title: Preparing For Steamworks - Patch 0.12
notes.notes:
[h1] IMPORTANT [/h1]

World Builder Steamworks implementation is under construction. I modified the way worlds are saved in this so you might notice a slight delay on initial load of the game the first time with this patch. I did everything I could to make sure this update goes smoothly but even with all of my testing some of you may experience problems and not be able to see your saves, not to worry there is a backup of your saves so if you run into any problems just email me at russell@gurujivr.com and I will fix your saves myself.

[h1] UPDATES [/h1]

- Fog default color is now white
- Brush size can be 50% larger now 
- Added a brush strength indicator to right controller
- Save files are now being zipped for faster upload/download

[h1] BUG FIXES [/h1]

- Shadows on Low Poly Objects are now showing properly
- Tutorial Block size is always proportional to your current size
- left / right hand drop down is now bigger
- Voice recognition wasn't working after multiple loads - now fixed
- Fog ui updating properly
- various minor bugs

notes.title: Patch 0.11 Grass Painter + Bug Fixes
notes.notes:
[h1] GRASS PAINTER [/h1]

On the objects tab of the menu you can now paint the grass! There are 2 known bugs right now 

- The grass disappears when the terrain is raised in certain areas, this is from the tessellation. Work arounds are painting on level surfaces.
- Grass Density doubles if grass is painted before terrain is edited, expect a solution for this tomorrow.

[h1] FEATURES [/h1]

Got in a few requests for you guys please if you have any suggestions comment in the community!
- Grass painting
- You can now see your current scale on your left hand ( will look in to cooler ways to do this in the future)
- X Button now has a label so you know what it's supposed to do.

[h1] FIXED BUGS [/h1]

- Closing the paint menu now ends painting mode
- Save menu now shows up properly
- Tutorial Transform mode

[h1] KNOWN ISSUES [/h1]

- If you encounter an error (most of them are silent) and then save or load, your save may be bugged, best solution is to restart the app. I will make this bug my main priority. Expect a fix within the next few days.
- ?? More Let me know
